brand.logoMark: Minimal stroke key icon (circle bow + right-angle shaft), always drawn in the accent color.

display.use: H1/H2 headlines, big stat numbers, italic for the 'Ключ' half of the wordmark

body.use: all UI text, body copy, buttons, labels

mono.use: VIN/lot numbers, all currency and numeric values, badges

compositionBarPalette.note: Illustrative segmented bar showing what the turnkey total is made of.

usageNotes: Site = light/warm theme (paper background). App = dark graphite theme. Same accent family bridges both.
Accent is used sparingly: primary CTAs, key numbers/totals, logo mark, active nav state, selected/optional-field indicators — never as a background wash.
Avoid left-border-accent cards and gradient washes; use plain 1px borders + generous whitespace instead.
The 'client shareable card' component always renders on the light/paper palette even inside the dark app, so a screenshot looks clean regardless of the app's theme.
Numbers, VINs, lot numbers and all money values are set in the mono font for scanability.
